name: dora-operational-resilience
title: DORA Operational Resilience Reporting
description: GDPR DSR workflow generation > BCBS239 model-risk readiness scoring > MiFID2 transaction-reporting compliance > operational resilience self-assessment > FCA consumer duty outcome dashboard: composite operational resilience reporting mandate.

steps.handoff: dsr_workflow and data_subject_obligations feed Stage 2 BCBS239 model-risk scoring
model_risk_score and bcbs239_gaps feed Stage 3 MiFID2 transaction-reporting check
transaction_reporting_gaps and remediation feed Stage 4 operational resilience assessment
resilience_self_assessment and scenario_gaps feed Stage 5 consumer duty dashboard
consumer_duty_outcomes and composite_resilience_mandate — final operational resilience mandate
